seed_selection: Suite seeds 1 through 10 were fixed on 2026-09-27 before any suite episode ran. Seed 6 is the milestone reference seed. Seeds must not be replaced, reordered for reporting, or dropped after results are known; a different seed set requires a new suite_id.
step_cap_rationale: 1000 NLE steps per episode, fixed before any suite episode ran. It matches the cap of the earlier documented trajectory smoke and bounds a real-model suite at 10000 hierarchical actions, since most exploration steps require one local model fallback decision.
